Results.ReviewText: The Weber Kettle is a legend. It needs no introduction. You say you have a Weber grill and the kettle is front and center in peoples minds. My grilling journey started probably 13 years ago or so, when my mom and stepdad got me Smokey Joe for Christmas. I was around 23 and clueless. See, I assumed the correct way to start charcoals was with starter fluid. Well all my burgers and steaks and chops tasted like starting fluid and I gave up. Fast forward to 2017 and I bought a Weber Spirit gas grill. Somewhere in there I discovered chimney starters and got one and pulled out the Smokey Joe. It was a new lease on life. After 6 months I saw the then-new Red Limited Edition kettle and I just had to have one! my girlfriend got it for my early Christmas present. It’s a HOSS, my poor Spirit just doesn’t get used as much as it used to. Be it burgers, brats, bacon, kabobs, smoking ribs, whatever, it’s perfect. In a week I’ll be ordering the Spring Green version!!
Results.Title: Simply the Greatest ever made

Very happy with my Webber. I am self employed and as such write my own schedule. That includes grilling on the Webber every Friday and Sunday. I have smoked Boston Butts, Brisket and made Beer Butt Chicken with no issues. Although the Brisket was a challenge! 

My only complaint is that the included Thermostat is to small and poorly placed for accurately measuring temperature at grill level. I installed a Tel-Tru BQ300 Barbecue Thermometer, with a 3 inch black dial at grill level and have had much better results when cook over indirect low heat and while smoking foods.

Overall I love my Webber.

Photos.Caption: Weber Kettle with ash catcher mounting ring.

Results.ReviewText:
I already owned a Weber Genesis 1000 gas grill and wanted to get a charcoal grill to go along with it. It turns out that my neighbor was replacing his Weber Kettle with a gas grill and had put the Kettle out to the curve. I asked him about it and he said that I could have it. I brought it home and fixed it up with new parts and used it for a few years before giving it to my cousin who was looking for a charcoal grill of his own.

I spotted another Weber Kettle outside a neighbors house and inquired about it. Sure enough, I brought that one home and fixed it up. I ended up taking it to my shop so that my guys could use it for making burgers and hotdogs. After I sold the shop, I left the Kettle with the new owner and again I was left without one of my own.

Years went by and recently I was able to make an opportunity buy to get a brand new Weber Original Kettle Premium Charcoal Grill. As I put it together I noticed many improvements in the new design. The built in ash catcher now snaps into place as opposed to old twist and lock design. The lid handle now has a heat shield and is bolted on, where before it was welded to the lid. The kettle bottom handles now have hooks molded into them for holding utensils. The addition of a thermometer is a welcome feature for keeping an eye on cooking temperatures. The hinged grill grate is a convenience that allows you to add more charcoal to each side without disturbing the main cooking area.

I am very with my Weber grills and would highly recommend them to anyone interested in a getting a grill for barbecuing whether it is gas or charcoal. My Weber collection has grown through the years although I replaced the Genesis 1000 with a Spirit E-210. I currently own Weber Performer SSP Touch-N-Go, Weber Spirit E-210 Gas Grill, Weber Smokey Mountain Cooker Smoker 18", Weber Original Kettle Premium Charcoal Grill 22" and a Smokey Joe.
Results.Title: Finally, my third Weber Kettle Charcoal Grill

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill model primarily due to the ash clean out method. The ashes can easily be dumped into the ash catcher by opening the bottom vents and moving them back and forth. It requires a little more action on my part to get more ash past the bottom vents and into the catcher, but this is no big problem. Regardless, it is a much better ash removal system that the aluminum plate method which always proved a bit of a problem. I would remove the plate by bending it a little bit to get past the clamps and this always produced an ash cloud no matter how careful I tried to be. I also like the simplicity of this grill. I for one do not need an outdoor kitchen appliance. The only extras are highly practical: small, semi-circular unattached stainless steel grate (about 10 inch wide and five inch high); good for keeping hot dogs or other smaller pieces of meat warm, but off the cooking grate.  The thermometer on the lid is another nice extra feature. I could maybe have used the model with the tray to place a cooking dish on; but, other than that, the model does everything I need it to do.

I added the aftermarket hinge and a port for probes.
Results.Title: Very well built

Results.ReviewText: I purchased my grill about one month ago : it's my first charcoal grill; I have used gas grills for years and I had forgotten how wonderful charcoal grills are. It's really a great grill and have plenty of fun to use it.
Results.Title: Awesome charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: I switched from my older Weber gas back to the kettle and enjoy it, but had to replace the top handle.  New handle fit but seems wobbly when lifting top.  Love the ash catcher.
Results.Title: Smokin' Salmon

Results.ReviewText: Got weber 22” for a wedding gift,came damaged,returned to store,out of season so they didn’t have one in stock. We got refund,was going to buy a cheaper grill,didn’t do it,so glad I didn’t,you get what you pay for.
Results.Title: Great grill,great taste!!

Results.ReviewText: This is an awesome grill produces great heat and get great smoked flavor. If you plan how you cook you can indirect heat and slow cook your steaks while direct heat bake the potatoes. The grilling rack has the feature on the sides that allows you to add more charcoal as needed so on those bigger cookouts you can smoke a good size roast or boston butt. Very versatile there are many different ways to cook or smoke on this grill.
Results.Title: produces great heat for cooking and a great smoke

Results.ReviewText: My wife presented me with a Weber for my birthday and I love it! The 22" size allows me to explore direct and indirect cooking, the top and bottom vents let me play with air, and the ash catcher is easy to empty. I love this grill and every time I use it I thank my wife for the perfect birthday present!
Results.Title: What a Birthday Present!

Results.ReviewText: I love my new Kettle Charcoal Grill.  I gave it 4 stars instead of 5 as the lid was damaged, however it did not stop me from using it so I was not going to return it as that would be to much of a hassle.  Other than that its an awesome grill.
Results.Title: love it

Results.ReviewText: Love the product but was unhappy that it can with parts missing my wife purchased it from Home depot using rhe Father's day special shipping directly to your home. When i opened it up it was like a shell grill missing several pieces. I called Weber directly since it was the copper Kettle which the lady from depot said came directly from Weber. I was not happy with the customer service i was spoke to on several occasions like i was lying it took 3 separate phone calls and 2 weekends to finally get all my pieces one lady didn't even put my order through. Also with all of this going wrong was never offered any kind of compensation until i insisted and i believe i hot a mitten. So once again very pleased with the product but very disappointed on how i was treated especially on Father's day gift
Results.Title: Great product

This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs.
